messages:
Noah Patel: morning! on my first week and can't access Grafana inference folder or the Datadog infra dashboard. who should I ask?
Elaine Rivera: hi Noah, welcome! :wave: file the infra-access form (https://go/redwood-access) and tag 'inference-platform'. include Datadog: infra-overview and Grafana folder: inference. I can expedite Grafana once it's in.
InfraBot: automated notice - Access request received (req id: AR-3472).
Noah Patel: filed with AR-3472, justification: "onboarding + dashboard familiarization".
Grafana Admin: added you as Viewer to folder 'inference'. link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/inference/inference-dashboards
Noah Patel: can see Grafana now, thanks. still waiting on Datadog.
Elaine Rivera: pinged the Datadog team. @Olivia usually grants view-only if you include org alias.
Noah Patel: org alias: inference-platform. also want Sentry alerts routed to #inference for sev1.
InfraBot: automated - Datadog view-only granted (user: Noah Patel). Sentry: invite sent to project 'inference-service'.
Noah Patel: got both, and a test alert arrived. all good. thanks!
Elaine Rivera: great — if you want a short tour of key panels/alerts later, I can do 20m today.
Noah Patel: yes please, 2pm works.
Grafana Admin: noted, closing the loop.
